summary: This is a preliminary prospectus supplement filed on Form 424B5 by ERP Operating Limited Partnership for a proposed offering of unsecured notes due 2031 and 2036. The notes will be unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing unsecured debt, including debt assumed in connection with a planned merger involving AvalonBay Communities and Equity Residential. The filing is a routine debt offering under an existing shelf registration, with no special-situation elements such as takeover or restructuring. The merger is referenced only in context of note ranking. Proceeds details are not finalized.
